what: Prior-allocation COUNT crossed with prior-allocation BYTES, with every prefix above the 12 GiB live set the measurement itself allocates.
why: the staircase sweep varies count and bytes together (bytes = n * 512 MiB) and its prefixes all sit below the measurement's own high-water, so peak bytes does not vary across its treatment at all. lo_hi and hi_lo here reach the same 24 GiB of prior peak with 24 and 48 allocations.
why_shuffled: the (cell, repeat) order is one seeded shuffle, not blocked by cell or by repeat. Blocking either reintroduces level-as-a-function-of-collection-position, which is the confound the staircase work needed three iterations to remove.
